# ChartSeries

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Represents a single data series in a chart. Similar to datasets in Chart.js or series in ApexCharts.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new ChartSeries()
```

## Properties

- [`Color`](#color): Color to use for this series (lines, bars, markers, etc.)
- [`DataPoints`](#datapoints): Data points for this series.
- [`Name`](#name): Series name/label (e.g., "Year Sales", "Product A", "Q1 Revenue") Used in legends and tooltips.
- [`Style`](#style): Series-specific styling options.

### `Color`

```csharp
Color Color { get; set; }
```

Color to use for this series (lines, bars, markers, etc.)

### `DataPoints`

```csharp
IList<ChartDataPoint> DataPoints { get; set; }
```

Data points for this series. Each data point contains a label, value, and optional format string.

> A list you can change.

### `Name`

```csharp
string Name { get; set; }
```

Series name/label (e.g., "Year Sales", "Product A", "Q1 Revenue") Used in legends and tooltips.

### `Style`

```csharp
ChartSeriesStyle Style { get; set; }
```

Series-specific styling options. Allows customization of line width, opacity, marker size, etc.
